title: Ten Million Resistance Deaths Are Projected By 2050
hook: Today's resistance toll is the start of a cancer-sized crisis.
closing: Without effective antibiotics, routine infections could carry the death toll of today's cancer.
question: Did you know resistance was this deadly?

segments.say: Resistance directly caused 1.27 million deaths in 2019. The crisis already kills at global scale.
Annual deaths are projected to reach 10 million by 2050. The toll could multiply dramatically.
Cancer now kills about 10 million yearly. Drug resistance is projected to reach the same scale.
